scope: After the first ReadyToSell dispatch, execute a larger second wave inside the same canonical F portable shared runner: inspect up to 300 real internet candidates, add at most 60 rows only from successfully opened land/plot listings, prepare real photo and canonical polygon evidence for up to 40 source-verified rows, and verify row-by-row visibility on the 8012 website.
acceptance: Only real successfully opened internet listings with positive land or plot evidence may be added.
Each accepted row must be visible on the 8012 website with source, status and report paths.
Downloaded photos must come from the actual listing page and polygons from canonical geometry.
No visual_match_score, VISION_COMPARED or 3.5+ confidence without a separate real visual comparison.
Git push and remote readback proof are required before metrics increase.
Do not create or request another runner.
hold_reason: Authoritative ReadyToSell handoff requires canonical 146 output and row-level site proof before any second-wave bulk work. Hold to preserve evidence quality and prevent out-of-order execution.
